tickets.name: First Points
tickets.note: Pull up a chair for 76ers at Pistons, because the first minute is where the money is! Embiid versus Reed in the circle, and nobody owns that jump ball! This opening could break either way, and we know which way we're leaning! If Reed controls the tip, he taps it to a guard, rolls to the rim, and boom, he's the first look! Collins is right behind him, ready to pounce on any mistake! Pick your poison, because any of them covers it!

tickets.name: Break the Seal
tickets.note: Bulls at Knicks, and here's how we see the opening act! Towns versus Smith for the tip, and Towns has owned that matchup in the circle! That puts the Knicks on the front foot to get on the board first. Bridges is the one we want finishing that first trip down the floor! Should the Bulls grab the first possession, Smith is our trigger man! If that first look rims out, Powell is right there to clean it up! The stakes are split so any one of them pays for the whole game. Beautiful!

tickets.name: Open Floor
tickets.note: Cavaliers at Thunder. Grab a seat, the first bucket is a story we've already read! Allen and Hartenstein meet in the circle, and Allen has been winning these jumps all season long! So the Cavaliers should get the first crack at it. If the Thunder steal the tip or get the first stop, Hartenstein is who we want firing first! Hartenstein stands alone in this one, and that's plenty!

tickets.name: Tip-Off Call
tickets.note: Here comes Lakers at Kings, and the opening tip is where our night begins! The jump ball goes Kessler against Sabonis, and Kessler has the springs tonight! Advantage Lakers for the opening bucket. The Kings get a stop? Then it's Sabonis running the other way for the first two! And Hunter is the backup plan on that possession, a fine backup plan at that! And Achiuwa sneaks in as the third man, just in case! Any of them scores first, and we're counting money!
